# function: opensearch

Compiles a DQL query, written in the stated grammar version or the latest, into an OpenSearch search request body, as a JSON string.

## Example Usage

```terraform
output "mock_error_count" {
  value = jsondecode(provider::dql::opensearch(
    "app:mock and level:error | count() by app",
    { time_field = "@timestamp", group_limit = 20 },
  ))
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
opensearch(query string, config object, grammar_version string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `query` (String) The DQL query.
1. `config` (Object) `time_field`: the field a time function buckets by. `group_limit`: how many groups each grouping field answers.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `grammar_version` (Variadic, String) The grammar version the query is written in, `<major>.<minor>`; omitted, the latest the provider supports.
